name: What kind of small businesses can benefit most from Generative Engine Optimization?

mainEntity.name: What kind of small businesses can benefit most from Generative Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small businesses that rely heavily on online presence for lead generation, sales, or customer engagement can benefit significantly from GEO. This includes e-commerce stores, local service providers, consultants, and content-driven businesses such as blogs or niche publications. If your business struggles with consistent content creation, keeping up with SEO trends, or competing in crowded online markets, GEO can provide a scalable solution to enhance visibility and attract a relevant audience.
acceptedAnswer.description: E-commerce stores, local service providers, consultants, and content-driven businesses can benefit most, especially if they struggle with consistent content creation or keeping up with SEO trends.
